card.name: Spots just before drug-interaction wording
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name or section number, or on a linking word like it, used or when, in drug-interaction text. The next words usually concern use together with another drug.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names in interaction or co-use warnings.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: Digits inside cross-references such as 12.3 or 7.2 in interaction sections.

modes.label: Linking words before co-use
modes.description: Words like it, used or when that lead into concomitant use with another drug.
modes.example: may be required when<< used>> concomitantly with BRAFTO

card.writes: It suppresses interact-words such as interaction and interacting, so it reduces how likely the model is to write them next.
card.plain: It fires in drug-interaction passages just before the text would say the drug interacts or is used with another drug.
